cat > storage/evaluator_test.go <<'EOF'
package storage

import (
 \"context\"
 \"fmt\"
 \"testing\"

 flipt \"github.com/markphelps/flipt/rpc\"
 \"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert\"
 \"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
)

func TestEvaluatorCutoffBoundary(t *testing.T) {
 distributions := []distribution{{VariantKey: \"first\"}, {VariantKey: \"second\"}}
 for _, tc := range []struct{ bucket int; key string }{{0, \"first\"}, {500, \"first\"}, {501, \"second\"}, {999, \"second\"}} {
  entity := \"\"
  for i := 0; i < 100000; i++ {
   candidate := fmt.Sprint(i)
   if int(crc32Num(candidate, \"flag\")) == tc.bucket { entity = candidate; break }
  }
  require.NotEmpty(t, entity)
  ok, got := evaluate(&flipt.EvaluationRequest{FlagKey: \"flag\", EntityId: entity}, distributions, []int{500, 1000})
  assert.True(t, ok)
  assert.Equal(t, tc.key, got.VariantKey)
 }
}

func TestEvaluatorRuleRank(t *testing.T) {
 ctx := context.Background()
 flag, err := flagStore.CreateFlag(ctx, &flipt.CreateFlagRequest{Key: t.Name(), Name: t.Name(), Enabled: true})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 first, err := segmentStore.CreateSegment(ctx, &flipt.CreateSegmentRequest{Key: t.Name()+\"-first\", Name: \"first\"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 second, err := segmentStore.CreateSegment(ctx, &flipt.CreateSegmentRequest{Key: t.Name()+\"-second\", Name: \"second\"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 _, err = ruleStore.CreateRule(ctx, &flipt.CreateRuleRequest{FlagKey: flag.Key, SegmentKey: first.Key, Rank: 1})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 _, err = ruleStore.CreateRule(ctx, &flipt.CreateRuleRequest{FlagKey: flag.Key, SegmentKey: second.Key, Rank: 2})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
  resp, err := evaluator.Evaluate(ctx, &flipt.EvaluationRequest{FlagKey: flag.Key, EntityId: fmt.Sprint(i)})
  require.NoError(t, err)
  assert.True(t, resp.Match)
  assert.Equal(t, first.Key, resp.SegmentKey)
  assert.Empty(t, resp.Value)
 }
}

func TestEvaluatorOperatorNormalization(t *testing.T) {
 c := constraint{Property: \"name\", Operator: \"PrEfIx\", Value: \"  ca \"}
 require.NoError(t, validate(c))
 assert.True(t, matchesString(c, \"  castle \"))
 c.Operator = \"SuFfIx\"
 c.Value = \" le \"
 assert.True(t, matchesString(c, \" castle \"))
 n, err := matchesNumber(constraint{Operator: \"Gt\", Value: \" 10 \"}, \" 11 \")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.True(t, n)
 b, err := matchesBool(constraint{Operator: \"TrUe\"}, \" true \")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.True(t, b)
 _, err = matchesNumber(constraint{Operator: \"eq\", Value: \"1\"}, \"x\")
 require.Error(t, err)
 _, err = matchesBool(constraint{Operator: \"true\"}, \"x\")
 require.Error(t, err)
}
EOF
